title: Provisioning Journey: first-traffic infographic + keyshot asset pack
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, single-slide infographic and a set of 6 keyshot PNGs that explain the Dedicated capacity provisioning-to-first-traffic flow. Visuals must cover: initial capacity selection, autoscale ramp behavior, SLA expectations & fallbacks, and a short troubleshooting callout. Assets will be used in the Quickstart modal, product docs, and the marketing one-pager for Dedicated launch.
acceptance_criteria: One A4-sized infographic (print + web) that narrates provisioning -> warmup -> first traffic -> autoscale events -> SLA snapshot
Six keyshot PNGs (1200x800) including: capacity selector, autoscale animation frames (3), SLA overview card, and a fallback/rollback vignette
Microcopy for each frame (20-40 chars headline + 1-sentence explanation) delivered in CSV
Figma file with named components and tokens (colors/spacing/typography) and export-ready slices
Design reviewed and approved by PM (Eve Larson) and Engineering lead (Vikram Rao) in Aha/PR comments
All assets exported with 2x and 3x density, and accessible alt text provided
design_assets_needed: Infographic master (A4, Figma) with layers for translation
Keyshot PNG exports: selector, autoscale-1, autoscale-2, autoscale-3, sla-card, fallback-vignette
Icon set: gpu-pool, histogram/throughput, shield/SLA, lightning/warmup, arrows/routing
One-page README with usage guidance for PMs and docs writers
mockup_notes: Visual language should be distinct from current onboarding decks: favor isometric micro-scenes rather than flat cards to increase perceived motion
Color palette should reuse console-900 for accents and use a warm neutral for background; ensure 4.5:1 contrast on body copy
Autoscale frames should illustrate a realistic traffic spike (x3 baseline) and show graceful scale-up with a 10s warmup visual — do not promise exact timing in copy
SLA overview card should communicate "SLA band" (e.g., target latency and uptime) and include fallback behavior: region failover -> model-variant fallback
Avoid quantitative percent numbers in the infographic where contractual language is required; link to SLA doc for exact figures
Prepare a compact vertical version for mobile modal (360px width) with stacked flow tiles
